atoms.name: Spanning trees and MST weight
atoms.one_line: A spanning tree has n-1 edges; the MST has the least total weight; add the weights of its edges.

atoms.name: Kruskal's algorithm
atoms.one_line: Sort edges, add each one that joins two different components (union-find); stop at n-1 edges.

atoms.name: Prim's algorithm
atoms.one_line: Grow one tree from a start vertex; always add the cheapest edge leaving the tree.

atoms.name: Cut and cycle properties
atoms.one_line: The lightest edge across any cut is safe; the heaviest edge of a cycle is unsafe (if unique).

atoms.name: Uniqueness and counting MSTs
atoms.one_line: Distinct weights give a unique MST; ties give several, counted by choices among tied edges.

atoms.name: Weight transformations
atoms.one_line: Adding a constant or squaring keeps the same MSTs; shortest paths may change; reciprocals give the maximum tree.

atoms.name: Updates and bottleneck paths
atoms.one_line: A new edge replaces the heaviest edge on the tree path if lighter; the tree path is the minimax path.
